ctx: SUBTITLE D. JUDICIAL PERSONNEL AND OFFICIALS

items.sub: SUBCHAPTER A. SECRETARIES OR STENOGRAPHERS FOR COUNTY JUDGES

l: (a) If the commissioners court on request of the county judge determines that a secretary or stenographer for the county judge is necessary, the court shall enter an order authorizing the county judge to employ a secretary or stenographer.
(b) The secretary or stenographer may be removed by the county judge.
The county judge of Jim Hogg County may employ one person for stenographic and secretarial duties.
